name: True Big Mode
author: Amazify
description: Turns Amazon Music Big Mode into a cleaner full-screen lyrics view with album-art exit behavior.

settings.label: Show lyrics
settings.description: Show lyrics beside the artwork. When off, center the artwork and suspend Karaoke Lyrics while True Big Mode is open.

settings.label: Enter fullscreen automatically
settings.description: Enter fullscreen when True Big Mode opens. Turn off to return to the window; browsers may require a user gesture.
